title: Thank You Card Marketing - Google Review Rate Increase

hero_stat.label: Consumers more likely to remember a business sending a thank you note

narration: This chart shows the percentage of consumers who are more likely to remember a business that sends a handwritten thank you note (68%). Additionally, customers who received a personalized thank you note were 35% more likely to leave a review, 20% more likely to increase their Google review rate, and 15% more likely to respond to a review request when coupled with a helpful resource. These statistics highlight the effectiveness of a targeted, tangible marketing strategy.
